record.question: What is the name of the first bilateral joint naval exercise between India and Indonesia?
record.explanation: Answer A: Samudra Shakti. The Navy’s original 12 November 2018 announcement calls the exercise Samudra Shakti and describes its inaugural India–Indonesia bilateral edition at Surabaya on 12–18 November 2018. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1552528&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
